versions.subject: Update web_cve_2021_22893_pulse_secure_rce_exploit.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    c-uri|contains:
        - '/dana-na/auth/'
        - '/dana-ws/'
        - '/dana-cached/'
selection2:
    c-uri|contains:
        - '?id='
        - '?token='
        - 'Secid_canceltoken.cgi'
        - 'CGI::param'
        - 'meeting'
        - 'smb'
        - 'namedusers'
        - 'metric'
    sc-status:
        - '200'
condition: selection1 and selection2 | count(sc-status) by src_ip > 3
timeframe: 30m
selection:
    message|contains:
        - 'patch(2104-)'
condition: selection
